newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 30.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 30.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The water level of Fekete Koros, a river crossing the border with Romania in southeastern Hungary is going down, while that of Kettos Koros is peaking.
- The association of investment companies urge tighter rules and amore transparent situation in the domestic securities trading.
- The first examinations show that the roof of Szolnoki Koolajkutato Vallalat was inflamed by inappropriate soldering and not by arson.
